title: Adding the Parts field to an Unassigned work order gives two Unassigned
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the Sales Representative field.
  2. Click the + button.
  3. Click "Sales Representative - Parts".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The + button shows beside the field.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens with "Sales Representative - Parts".

Step 3:

  • "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts" both read "Unassigned".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R5: “Picking "Sales Representative - Parts" closes the menu and replaces the one field with two fields, in this order: "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts".”
  • S2-R6: “Both fields start with the person who was in the one field, or "Unassigned" if it was empty. Adding the Parts field on its own changes nobody's credit.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
